hard_fails.actual: Subscriber-role members (qa_member_owner, qa_member_other - the exact persona roster the runbook defines as 'member') can never edit or delete their own pending suggestion. Roadmap_Permissions::can_edit_item() requires user_can($user_id,'edit_post',$post_id) to pass first (product-roadmap/includes/class-roadmap-permissions.php:199); roadmap_item is registered with capability_type='post' with no map_meta_cap override (class-roadmap-cpt.php ~line 135), so it inherits CORE post capabilities. Subscribers lack the base 'edit_posts' capability entirely, so WP's meta-cap mapping fails before ownership is even checked - roadmap_edit_own_items (granted only to the WP 'author' role, which no QA persona holds) is unreachable dead code. can_delete_item() is worse: it requires 'roadmap_delete_items' with no '_own' variant at all (class-roadmap-permissions.php:229), so NO non-admin/editor role can ever delete their own item. Verified live: PUT and DELETE /wp-json/roadmap/v1/items/{id} both return 403 rest_forbidden for qa_member_owner on their own post 1307 (post_author matched current user).

Setting an invalid Pro license produces no admin notice anywhere (dashboard, settings, any wp-admin screen) even though Free/Pro features keep working correctly (no fatal, no silent feature loss - that part of the contract holds). Root cause: roadmap-pro-addon.php registers 'add_action("plugins_loaded",[$this,"init"])' (default priority 10) from INSIDE RoadmapProAddon::define_hooks(), which itself only runs when roadmap_pro_addon() is invoked from a plugins_loaded callback registered at PRIORITY 20 (bottom of roadmap-pro-addon.php). By the time that priority-20 callback registers the priority-10 'init' callback, WordPress's hook iterator for the CURRENT plugins_loaded pass has already moved past priority 10, so init() never executes on any request. Confirmed live: is_textdomain_loaded('roadmap-pro-addon') returns false even though init() unconditionally calls load_plugin_textdomain() - proving init() never runs. This silently breaks BOTH the license-invalid admin notice (show_license_notice(), roadmap-pro-addon.php:715) and all Pro i18n string translation, on every request, regardless of license state.

failures.triage_note: Root cause in product-roadmap/includes/class-roadmap-cpt.php (roadmap_item registered with capability_type='post', no map_meta_cap) and class-roadmap-permissions.php:184-230 (can_edit_item/can_delete_item). Fix: either register the CPT with a custom capability_type + map_meta_cap=true so 'own post' ownership is honored for subscriber/contributor, or change can_edit_item()/can_delete_item() to check post_author === current user OR the explicit *_own_items caps directly instead of gating everything behind WP's native edit_post/delete_post meta cap (which subscribers can never pass regardless of ownership).

failures.triage_note: Root cause: roadmap-pro-addon.php bottom-of-file bootstrap calls roadmap_pro_addon() from inside add_action('plugins_loaded', fn, 20); that instantiation's constructor -> define_hooks() -> add_action('plugins_loaded',[$this,'init']) (priority 10) registers too late for the CURRENT plugins_loaded pass to reach it (WP_Hook does not rewind past an already-processed priority). Fix: call $this->init() directly and synchronously from define_hooks()/the constructor instead of re-hooking onto the same in-flight action, or hook init() onto a later-firing action (e.g. 'init' the WP hook, not 'plugins_loaded').

failures.actual: No notice appears on any wp-admin screen (dashboard, roadmap settings, license tab itself does show 'License is invalid' inline - only that one spot). is_textdomain_loaded('roadmap-pro-addon') === false. Free/Pro features themselves keep working with an invalid license (no fatal, no silent disablement) - only the notice/i18n side is broken.
